Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Private deployment demo + compliance runbook

Hi Dylan,

We just signed up via your self-serve flow and selected the 'Private / VPC' option — excited to see Redwood in a locked-down environment. I work on IT & Privacy at PrivacyHealth. A couple quick items before we lock the demo slot:

- Can we get a short SOC 2 summary (not full report) to share with our security team?
- Do you have a provisioning/runbook template for on-prem or VPC pilots (network ports, firewall rules, KMS options)?
- Availability: we prefer mornings PT next week (Apr 17–19) but can be flexible.

Attaching the intake form from our side in the self-serve confirmation (not included here). Please loop in whoever will join from engineering for the technical deep dive.

Best,
Amy
Amy Reynolds
Head of IT & Privacy
PrivacyHealth

Hi Amy — thanks for signing up and for the clear list. Glad to connect.

Quick answers and next steps:
- SOC2 summary: Olga (SE) has a short one-pager we usually share; I'll ask her to attach it.
- Provisioning/runbook: we have a template with the typical network and KMS options — Olga will drop a runbook template and a sample network checklist.
- Demo timing: we have open slots on Apr 17 at 09:30 PT and Apr 18 at 10:00 PT for a 60–75 minute on-prem deep-dive with SE + solutions engineer + CS. Please confirm which you'd prefer.

Vivek (SDR) — can you add a calendar hold once Amy confirms?
Olga — can you prepare the SOC2 summary and the provisioning runbook (PDF and DOCX)?

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your procurement window as well.

Regards,

From: Amy Reynolds <amy.reynolds@privacyhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@privacyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 11:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private deployment demo + compliance runbook

Hi Dylan — thanks for the fast reply.

We can take Apr 17 at 09:30 PT.
A couple follow-ups for Olga/your team to know ahead of the demo:

- Our security team prefers a one-page SOC2 summary that calls out data flow, encryption-at-rest, encryption-in-transit, and 3rd-party subprocessors. If you have a checklist rather than a long report that’d be ideal.
- For the runbook, key items: network egress IP ranges, port list for KV caching and model traffic, expected bandwidth during token-heavy tests, and any required inbound rules.
- Procurement: we’ll need an initial SOW draft and a high-level pricing estimate to circulate. Procurement contact copied.

Can you also confirm whether the demo environment will include KV cache behavior (we want to see cold+warm cache response times)?

Thanks — see you Apr 17.

— Amy

Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: PrivacyHealth — Private deployment demo & compliance runbook

Hi Amy — forwarding the meeting invite and the materials we discussed.

Attached:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (one-page SOC 2 summary + data flow diagram)
- provisioning-runbook-template.docx (runbook with network checklist and KMS notes)

Meeting: Apr 17, 2028 09:30 PT — 75 minutes (Technical deep-dive + procurement Q&A). Calendar invite sent to all.

Short answers inline:
- KV cache: yes — we will demo cold vs warm cache latency with a short live load pattern and show token-level latency breakdown in the Console.
- Bandwidth: runbook includes an example traffic profile for a 50k token/hour test and suggested burst policies.
- SOW/estimate: Grace from CS will follow up with a starter SOW and a ballpark pricing sheet immediately after the demo.
